message.content:
This vertical magazine cover illustration features three caricatured people on two red scooters speeding along a road under a bright sky.

On the left, a slender man in a dark suit, white shirt, and red tie rides a small red scooter. He has an exaggeratedly long face and open mouth, with one arm raised and one leg kicked out. To the right, a larger woman in a purple long-sleeved top and light headscarf drives a similar but larger red scooter. Her expression is stern. Seated behind her is a smaller male figure in a white shirt, holding onto her waist with a neutral expression.

The red scooters have rounded, retro-styled bodies with glowing circular headlights and chrome mirrors. They appear to be in motion over a dark road with yellow perspective lines. The background consists of soft, pale blue and pink clouds.

Prominent red text at the top reads "TEMPO". Smaller text includes "TENANG, IBU SUDAH DI SINI" at the bottom, and other Indonesian phrases, dates, a price, and a barcode.
